cohort: The study included 180 children aged 5 to 15 years attending a tertiary care hospital in Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu, Southern India.
finding: Eczema, allergic rhinitis, asthma, and paternal unemployment were significantly associated with increased odds of food allergy, while male gender and older age (12-15 years) were linked to reduced risk.
mod_finding: A higher prevalence of food allergy was observed in children delivered via cesarean section, although the association did not reach statistical significance in all analyses.
